findings.reader: A well-crafted bounded news article: it answers what changed, explains the causal mechanism (sketch as spatial map, comment as narrowed edit target) in plain warm language, keeps vendor claims and independent testing distinct, preserves uncertainty about rollout and limits, and gives a specific proportionate test the reader can run.
findings.facts: Factually sound dated news report: release date, features, availability, limits, performance and hands-on claims all match the supplied source excerpts, with vendor claims labelled as company claims and Axios testing correctly bounded as a small task set rather than a benchmark.
